headline_claim_text: India adult account ownership reached 77.53% in 2021 and 89.02% in 2024.
primary_evidence_finding: Directly reproduced via World Bank Data API indicator FX.OWN.TOTL.ZS for India.
epistemic_limitation_or_error: Covers age 15+; self-reported survey measure, not administrative core banking ledger.

headline_claim_text: Female account ownership closed the gap with male ownership (89.25% female vs 88.81% male in 2024).
primary_evidence_finding: Directly reproduced via World Bank API indicators FX.OWN.TOTL.FE.ZS and FX.OWN.TOTL.MA.ZS.
epistemic_limitation_or_error: Reflects gross ownership of accounts, not transaction velocity or independent usage.

headline_claim_text: About 35% of Indian account owners had inactive accounts in 2021 (~7x developing world average).
primary_evidence_finding: Verified as published finding in World Bank Findex 2021 Report (Chapter 2, p. 154).
epistemic_limitation_or_error: Taken from published report tables; not independently re-calculated from raw microdata CSV.

headline_claim_text: 42% of female account owners had inactive accounts vs 30% of male owners (12 pp gap) in 2021.
primary_evidence_finding: Verified as published finding in World Bank Findex 2021 India Country Brief (p. 2).
epistemic_limitation_or_error: Taken from secondary country brief; raw microdata extraction scheduled for Phase 2.

headline_claim_text: PMJDY covers 59.59 crore accounts with ₹3,24,069.14 crore deposits as of 14 Oct 2026.
primary_evidence_finding: Directly scraped, parsed, and mathematically verified from https://pmjdy.gov.in/account.
epistemic_limitation_or_error: Reflects gross administrative accounts opened under the scheme; includes inoperative accounts.

headline_claim_text: Regional Rural Banks carry 84.7% rural accounts and 58.4% female share, with only 37.4% RuPay card coverage.
primary_evidence_finding: Directly recalculated from live PMJDY table rows across bank categories.
epistemic_limitation_or_error: RuPay card issuance reflects cards dispatched, not cards activated or actively transacting.

headline_claim_text: Low RuPay card coverage in RRBs proves an account-usage or inactivity deficit.
primary_evidence_finding: Logical leap. Card issuance does not equal usage. Rural users heavily use cardless AePS biometric withdrawals.
epistemic_limitation_or_error: Conflates lack of a plastic debit card with account dormancy or unwillingness to transact.

headline_claim_text: 27.18% of Indian adults met the national financial literacy benchmark in NCFE NFLIS-2019.
primary_evidence_finding: Verified as official benchmark finding in NCFE NFLIS-2019 Report (OECD-INFE methodology).
epistemic_limitation_or_error: Reflects 2018–2019 survey baseline; not a real-time 2026 measure.

headline_claim_text: State-level literacy percentages in CSV (Kerala 36.1%, Bihar 18.2%) are primary NCFE data.
primary_evidence_finding: Audit reveals CSV state figures were model-interpolated proxies, not exact verbatim NCFE tables (Kerala ~39%, Bihar ~20%).
epistemic_limitation_or_error: State-level figures in CSV lack exact provenance to official report tables.

headline_claim_text: RBI Financial Inclusion Index stood at 64.2 in March 2024 (Access: 71.0, Usage: 61.8, Quality: 56.2).
primary_evidence_finding: Directly reproduced from RBI Annual Report 2024–25 official release tables.
epistemic_limitation_or_error: Composite national macroeconomic indicator; does not disaggregate to person-level or district-level.

headline_claim_text: 2,421 operational Centres for Financial Literacy (CFLs) active across India as of 31 March 2025.
primary_evidence_finding: Directly reproduced from RBI Annual Report 2024–25 FIDD section.
epistemic_limitation_or_error: Measures physical presence and institutional infrastructure, not individual camp efficacy.

headline_claim_text: 21.17% of PMJDY accounts are inoperative as of 22 January 2025.
primary_evidence_finding: Cited in published parliamentary QA reports; primary Hansard PDF text pending local checksumming.
epistemic_limitation_or_error: Applies exclusively to PMJDY accounts, not national all-bank commercial savings accounts.

headline_claim_text: UPI transaction volume expanded by 274% from FY 2021–22 (4,596 Cr) to FY 2024–25 (17,200 Cr).
primary_evidence_finding: Directly reproduced from NPCI published product statistics portal.
epistemic_limitation_or_error: Measures aggregate national retail payments; skewed toward urban smartphone commerce.

headline_claim_text: Macro UPI and AePS transaction growth proves that dormant Jan Dhan accounts are reactivating.
primary_evidence_finding: Methodological fallacy. Aggregate transaction volume growth does not measure dormant account reactivation.
epistemic_limitation_or_error: Extreme Pareto concentration in payment volumes hides persistent rural account dormancy.

headline_claim_text: FIPI sensitivity analysis exhibits >90% rank stability across alternative weight schemes.
primary_evidence_finding: Formally recalculated: Spearman rho >= 0.985 across all schemes; top-5 state set is 100% invariant.
epistemic_limitation_or_error: Informal '90%' claim in text lacked mathematical formulation; now rigorously defined via Spearman rho.
